decisions.reason: A multi-model formwork profile system is a core consumable line for precast plants, and with industry demand growing it continues to earn recurring revenue.
Automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is embedded in its integrated plant and retrofit offering.
Shuttering magnet blocks are standard recurring-demand accessories, and the multi-model line costs little to maintain.
This magnetic formwork component rounds out the formwork range, and keeping it carries low ongoing cost.
Although it is only a minor mentioned accessory that could be consolidated, as D was, keeping it in the magnetic formwork portfolio remains cheap.
